name: Draft Release
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      new_version:
        description: 'New version number (e.g., 1.2.3) - if not provided, auto-determined'
        required: false
        type: string
      model:
        description: 'Model abbreviation (codex, glm, kimi) - if not provided, uses default'
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  draft_release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check actor permissions
        if: github.actor != 'dyoshikawa' && github.actor != 'cm-dyoshikawa'
        run: |
          echo "Error: Only dyoshikawa and cm-dyoshikawa can trigger this workflow"
          exit 1

      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Select OpenCode Model
        id: select_model
        uses: ./actions/select-opencode-model
        with:
          input-text: ${{ github.event.inputs.model }}

      - name: Get current version
        id: get_version
        run: |
          if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.new_version }}" ]; then
            echo "version=${{ github.event.inputs.new_version }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            # Auto-determine version using release-dry-run logic
            VERSION=$(npm version --dry-run 2>/dev/null | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f2)
            echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Create release branch and PR
        run: |
          VERSION="${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }}"
          MODEL="${{ steps.select_model.outputs.cleaned-text }}"
          
          # Create release branch
          git checkout -b "release/$VERSION"
          
          # Update package.json with new version
          npm version "$VERSION" --no-git-tag-version
          
          # Commit changes
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add package.json
          git commit -m "Release version $VERSION"
          
          # Push branch
          git push origin "release/$VERSION"
          
          # Create pull request
          gh pr create \
            --title "Release v$VERSION" \
            --body "Automated release PR for version $VERSION" \
            --base main \
            --head "release/$VERSION"
          
          # Create draft release
          gh release create "v$VERSION" \
            --title "Release v$VERSION" \
            --draft \
            --notes "Draft release for version $VERSION"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
